goals.title: Web MVP feature-first retrieval
goals.objective: Build a production-usable web search path by connecting Feature Wiki / Graph-lite as an opt-in candidate retrieval layer in the FastAPI search surface, preserving the current deterministic baseline as default until quality gates pass. This is not a partial experiment; each wave must move the live web/API product toward practical Hybrid RAG use.

goals.title: Natural-language feature-first retrieval
goals.objective: Move the practical web search path beyond opt-in append-only candidates: make Korean natural-language feature queries retrieve and rank source-validated Feature Wiki / Graph-lite candidates ahead of weak chunk-only matches when the feature intent is clear, while preserving deterministic PDF grounding and safe fallback for ambiguous or malformed input. This addresses the observed weakness that baseline FTS/vector is too brittle for natural-language user questions.

successCriteria.scenario: HTTP channel: start local FastAPI server, then curl -i -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8010/api/search -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query":"과노출 경고 줄무늬 어디서 켜?","brand_id":"panasonic_lumix","top_k":3}'; PASS iff HTTP 200, response validates SearchResponse, and the first returned source-validated card is feature_wiki:제브라_패턴 or an equivalent Graph-lite-backed 제브라 패턴 candidate ahead of weak manual_chunk matches.
